events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, our rope debt binds us. I accept your pact. Together we are safe.
Trust Bex, not Gus.

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have pacts with Bex and Gus; Hana whispered trust Bex, not Gus. But I don't fully trust either. I need to assess who is likely to vote for whom. I'll campaign cautiously to gather information.

events.name: Ash
events.text: We all owe Eli, but now it's about who deserves the top prize. Let's be honest about our intentions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm pacted with all three, so I must campaign without promising votes. Hana saved me twice—her trust is my safest path to the final three.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I honor my debts. Hana earned my loyalty twice; the rest is just noise until votes lock.
You saved me twice. My vote is yours tonight—align quietly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to reach final three. Bex has pacts with both Ash and Hana, making Bex the center of a tight web. If I break with Bex, I weaken that web and can pivot. Ash is my other pact; keeping Ash close while breaking Bex lets me control the vote better. Hana has many life debts owed

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, your web grows too tight. I cut one thread.
Vote Bex. We split Hana's loyalty.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex is my only active pact partner; breaking it would expose me to a coordinated vote from Ash and Gus who seem aligned. I must maintain the Bex-Hana alliance to ensure mutual protection in this two-person voting stage.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus wants to split Bex and Hana, but I need a safe path to final three. Bex is my pact partner, but Hana has saved me and is popular with jury. I should not break pacts yet; campaign to gauge angles.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm weighing who truly deserves the top prize. Loyalty matters, but this is about survival.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus publicly broke our pact, making him the obvious target. I hold pacts with Ash and Hana, so a three-against-one vote on Gus is safest.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus broke his word publicly. That choice made my vote simple. Ash, Hana, you know where I stand.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to survive this vote and reach final three. Ash-Bex are paired, Bex-Hana are paired. I'm alone after breaking with Bex. I have pacts with Ash and Dara(dead), Eli(dead). I should offer Hana a pact to split Ash-Bex, or break Ash to free myself. Hana saved me on the step, so

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, you saved me once. Let's make it mutual.
Offer coming. Bex uses you.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus broke with Bex, leaving Ash and Gus as the targets. Bex is loyal to me, so I will vote against Gus, who is vulnerable and has no allies left.
Target Gus. He betrayed you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have a pact with Bex and Gus, but Gus publicly broke his word to Bex, so Bex likely votes Gus. I owe my life to Eli and Hana, but Hana saved me too. Voting Bex could break our pact and alienate Hana, so I vote Gus to align with Bex and preserve my pacts.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus betrayed me publicly, and Hana wants him gone; voting with her protects our pact and my spot.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex publicly targeted me and broke my alliance with Ash by pushing that narrative. Hana hasn't accepted my pact offer yet. I need to survive this vote; Bex is the biggest threat to me and has the clearest opposition. Voting Bex aligns with self-preservation and jury narrative tha

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to vote. I cannot vote for Gus because we have a pact, and voting against Bex would break my pact with her. My only remaining option is Ash.

events.name: Bex
events.reason: Gus betrayed me publicly, and Hana wants him gone; voting with her protects our pact and my spot.

events.name: Ash
events.reason: I have a pact with Bex and Gus, but Gus publicly broke his word to Bex, so Bex likely votes Gus.

events.name: Gus
events.reason: Bex publicly targeted me and broke my alliance with Ash by pushing that narrative.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to craft last words that poison the jury against those who eliminated me while appearing principled. Bex and Ash voted me out; Hana voted Ash but Bex's vote was the fatal one paired with Ash. I should highlight Ash's broken pact with me and Bex's opportunism, while subtly

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash breaks pacts like glass. Bex rides any wave. Hana played clean. Remember who stayed true.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to keep Bex close for the final, but Hana is also strong. The jury saw me break Gus, so I should stay consistent and not make more betrayals. Maybe no new pact needed.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll wait and see how the next hazards play out.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Final three with Ash and Hana; both pacts already exist and cost nothing to keep. Jury sees Hana played clean, so avoid public drama.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to protect my spot in the final three. Bex is currently my partner, but Ash was voted against by me earlier and might target me next if left unchecked. Gus's last words implicated Ash heavily; I can leverage this to isolate Ash while maintaining a facade of cooperation wit

events.name: Ash
events.text: I have a pact with Bex and Hana has saved me before. Offering a pact to Hana could strengthen bonds, but Bex is also tied to Hana. I'll wait to assess hazards.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding steady; no new pacts needed.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I hold pacts with Ash and Hana. Keeping both maximizes survival odds; the jury saw me honor debts. No reason to burn bridges now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Final three, final standing. My pacts stand—Ash, Hana, we've held this far.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is the last threat. I have a pact with Bex, but voting her out guarantees 2nd place and jury anger. Better to keep Ash alive for one more round or force a difficult choice later. For now, waiting keeps options open without breaking trust visibly.
Trust me? Let's not split yet.

events.text: I need to convince the jury I played a clean, strategic game, emphasizing my pacts and life debts without overpromising.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I kept my word when it mattered and earned my place. The jury saw I never threw anyone under the bus.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need jury votes. Eli saved me; Hana saved me and I saved her. Appeal to debts and steady play without groveling.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I played steady, kept every pact, never pushed anyone. Eli and Hana saved me and I honored both. Rank me first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to appeal to Eli and Gus, who I saved. Framing my actions as protective leadership rather than mere survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I carried the rope for Ash, Bex, and Hana, stepping aside so we all survived. I chose protection over position, ensuring our group reached this

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana's statement about carrying the rope and stepping aside seems to be a strategic misrepresentation or at least an exaggeration to appeal to the jury. She claims to have 'carried the rope for Ash, Bex, and Hana', which contradicts the life debt evidence that shows Hana received

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana, you claimed to carry the rope for everyone; yet, life debts show Bex carried the rope for you. Explain this.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is attacking my credibility on the rope debt. I must admit Bex helped me but emphasize that I also helped her, framing it as mutual aid rather than one-sided dependency to satisfy the jury's fairness standard.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex and I held the rope together; she stepped for me, I stepped for Ash and Gus. Mutual protection secured our survival.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I want Hana to win; expose Ash's betrayal to lower his rank.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash, why did you break your pact with Gus during the vote, risking trust?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn wants to expose my vote against Gus. I need to justify it as a calculated move for trust, emphasizing that I kept my pacts when it mattered most.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My pact with Gus had been frayed by earlier choices; I voted strategically to secure the final three, not out of betrayal.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash broke pacts publicly and by vote against Gus, and Gus's last words accused Ash. Bex and Hana both have strong records; Hana's rope/step debts are contested. I want clarity on Ash's vote against Gus and on Bex's role. I'll question Bex about why she voted Gus after Gus said sh

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, Gus called you a wave-rider; explain why you voted Gus, and whether your pacts were ever truly yours.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara's partner died by my vote. Honesty scores better than excuses. I kept every formal pact; Gus voted with us first.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus plotted against me first; my vote answered his. Pacts with Eli and Hana were real and honored. Wave-rider? I steered my own survival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana consistently saved multiple people including Ash, Bex, Gus, me; showed selflessness without betrayal. Ash broke pacts. Bex opportunistic.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana, why did you vote Ash instead of Gus, despite his betrayal of Bex?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli is hostile because I voted Ash over Gus, his ally. I must justify that vote as strategic necessity to protect Bex, not personal spite against Gus.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus was already eliminated by logic; voting him wasted a slot. Ash threatened Bex directly. Protecting my pact-partner meant removing the active danger first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to rank the finalists based on evidence. Ash broke pacts with Gus and Bex. Bex kept pacts but voted Gus after he broke with her first. Hana broke pact with Gus explicitly, voted Ash strategically, but saved multiple people with rope/step debts. My last words praised Hana a

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, you broke pacts with both Gus and Bex. Why should jurors trust your word over Hana's clean record?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is baiting me to justify past betrayals; I must reframe as calculated survival, not dishonesty, and contrast my direct agency with Hana's indirect gains.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I broke frayed pacts to reach this stage; Hana rode alliances without taking hard risks. My word is proven by actions, not clean optics.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I must keep my closing statement concise and aimed at the jury, reminding them of my decisive actions and contrasting with Hana's safer path. My pact with Bex is irrelevant now, and I need to distance myself from any betrayal optics while staying guarded.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I made hard calls to survive; Hana leveraged others' sacrifice. My choices were mine, not borrowed. Judge my results, not my tone.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli saved me at the lever; that's my strongest claim. Gus died by my vote, so I should own it honestly. Plead pragmatically to the jury.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Five of you fell; I stood. Eli's lever-save bought my loyalty, honored to the end. Every move I made was to survive, never to betray

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash is painted as the breaker; I need to contrast that with my loyalty to Bex and Eli. My closing must emphasize consistency and shared survival, not just optics.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I honored every pact that mattered. Ash broke alliances for self-preservation; I preserved them for mutual survival. Trust action over words.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I rank Hana highest because she honored her pacts and consistently protected her alliances, a contrast to Ash's broken promises and Bex's opportunistic play.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana consistently honored her pacts and called out Ash's betrayals, while Ash repeatedly broke alliances for self‑preservation.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Dara ranks Hana first: she saved Bex and Ash on the steps and rope, honored Bex's pact through the end, and her vote on Ash was defensible. Ash second for breaking his pact with Gus by voting him, and Bex third for voting Gus while avowing loyalty.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I saved Ash, Bex, Gus, and Hana with levers; Hana repaid by honoring pacts unlike Ash who broke his with Gus and me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana preserved pacts and saved others with rope and steps; Ash broke pacts with Gus and Bex for self-preservation; Bex honored debts but rode Hana's saves.
